title: The meter nobody can reconcile
blurb: Counter updates were not atomic and replay billed twice.
prompt: Finance found spend that did not match provider invoices, and a support engineer saw a tenant billed twice for one request after a retry. The model-generated draft increments per-model counters in separate commands and stores usage without any idempotency key. Review it, fix it, and prove counters, replay and reporting all agree.
aiNote: The draft increments each model's counter with a separate HINCRBY and sets no expiry, so concurrent writes can half-apply and the key never resets, and it stores usage without the Idempotency-Key so a retried report is recorded and billed twice.
testIdea: Replay the same usage report and assert one stored row and one billed amount; increment two model counters concurrently and assert the hash updates atomically; wait out the window and assert the counter key is gone.
followUps: Should spend be reserved before a call or reconciled after it, and what does each choice cost?
How do you bill a request whose provider usage arrives after the response?
What makes a pricing version auditable months later?
